description.zh:
分片集群实例中Shard节点ID。

> 当**DBInstanceId**参数传入的是分片集群实例ID时，本参数为必填。
description.en:
The ID of the shard node in the sharded cluster instance.

> This parameter is required if the **DBInstanceId** parameter specifies the ID of a sharded cluster instance.

description.zh: 实例所属的地域ID，您可以通过调用[DescribeDBInstanceAttribute](~~62010~~)进行查询。
description.en: The ID of the region where the instance is located. Call the [DescribeDBInstanceAttribute](~~62010~~) operation to query the region ID.

title.zh: 查询实例的备份使用量

descriptions.zh: 分片集群备份用量的计费规则是每个分片单独计费，本接口只支持查询单分片的备份用量。
descriptions.en: Backup usage for a sharded cluster is billed on a per-shard basis. You can use this operation to query the backup usage for a single shard.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dds describe-backup-storage --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id dds-2zeb2d64cb46xxxx --node-id d-2zee48956b4axxxx --region cn-hangzhou
